name: adels-grimoire
description: Hover documentation for every SystemVerilog keyword and the UVM library, plus Jasper CDC/RDC and Superlint violations as squiggles

grimoire.libraryPaths.description: Extra documentation folders, searched before the built-in SystemVerilog and UVM pages. Each holds subfolders of <name>.md pages; the sv and uvm subfolders apply only to SystemVerilog files and the params subfolder only to Tcl files.

grimoire.reportGlob.description: Workspace glob for Jasper CDC/RDC and Superlint violation CSV reports to show as diagnostics. Empty disables them.
